Global risk appetite favors US mega-cap tech liquidity; Indonesian tech stocks trade at a structural discount due to thin foreign flows and regulatory overhang, so relative performance will stay negat
sectors.ai: Buy US-listed AI/data infrastructure names (PLTR, ORCL, NOW) on pullbacks; Indonesia tech remains a laggard—rotate into RUNS/YELO only for short-term momentum, not core. MSTR's volatility is a hedge, not a hold. Expect US mega-cap AI spend to keep lifting the aggregate; add exposure via US ADRs, as IDX tech lacks liquidity and earnings catalysts.

US crypto/fintech volatility (COIN, HOOD) creates periodic beta for Indonesian fintech-linked names, but local regulatory clarity on P2P lending remains the key long-term catalyst.
sectors.ai: Buy Indonesian financials selectively: BTPN (+7.8%) and INPC (+9%) lead local re-rating on NIM stabilization and digital-bank cost cuts, while US crypto-exposed names (COIN, HOOD) are sentiment spillover, not fundamentals. Add BTPN on pullbacks to IDR 2,600; avoid chasing IMJS/NICK speculative spikes. Position for Q3 earnings beats in banks with strong CASA growth, as BI rate cuts lag but loan repricing supports margins.

themes: Indonesia's coal export parity to Asian benchmark prices remains structurally supportive for PTBA and MINE despite US softness, driven by China/India thermal demand and domestic DMO floor pricing.

Energy transition capex in Indonesia, including geothermal and gas-to-power projects, underpins long-term contracts for NICE and RMKO, insulating them from commodity spot volatility.
sectors.ai: Buy selective coal and nickel names on the ID-listed strength; MINE, NICE, and PTBA confirm domestic momentum while US lag is noise. Favor PTBA for thermal upside and KRAS for nickel leverage into EV demand. Trim FIRE and LABA into spikes; hold ISSP for smelter optionality. Watch for profit-taking after +6-12% runs, but add on dips toward 5-day support.

Toll-road and utility operators (MIRA, AXON) ride the Jokowi-to-Prabowo continuity in PPP infrastructure spending, yet regulatory tariff caps cap upside without volume acceleration.

KUAS and PACK momentum reflects niche logistics/port capex, hold winners but trim into strength. Infrastructure aggregate signal NORMAL implies no systemic risk—rotate into laggards with earnings visibility ahead of Q3 results.

US exposure remains a drag, so overweight local-currency pure plays. Accumulate on dips toward support; trim names with US revenue links.

sectors.name: Logistics
themes: Indonesia's e-commerce and manufacturing export volumes are structurally compounding, driving durable demand for third-party logistics and cold-chain assets beyond cyclical rate spikes.
Government infrastructure spend on ports and toll roads is lowering transit costs and unlocking new corridors, favoring operators with integrated land-sea networks over single-mode players.
Fuel-price subsidy reforms and diesel-indexed tariffs are creating margin predictability for trucking and shipping firms, rewarding scale operators that can pass through costs efficiently.
sectors.ai: Logistics is breaking out on domestic volume recovery and rate normalization; add exposure now via SAFE/TRUK leaders, but rotate out of airline-linked GIAA/TAXI into pure freight names before the next earnings round. Watch for port-congestion data as the swing factor; if it tightens, trim into strength.

sectors.name: Property & Real Estate
themes: Jakarta's new capital-city spillover and transit-oriented development (MRT/LRT) corridors are structurally re-rating landbanks, favoring developers with prime central holdings over suburban inventory.

Consolidation among small-cap developers is accelerating as stricter listing rules and ESG disclosure push weaker players to sell assets or merge, benefiting scale players with clean balance sheets.
sectors.ai: Buy selective exposure to Jakarta landbank owners and asset-backed developers (UANG, CBDK, PPRO) into year-end, as rate-cut expectations and foreign inflow rotation lift liquidity. Avoid chasing speculative movers (CBPE, WINR) without earnings confirmation. Trim on any sharp index pullback; hold core positions through Q1 2025 for revaluation upside.
